description: dotnet new templates for an ASP.NET Core 10 Enterprise Modular Monolith: Clean Architecture modules with layering and isolation enforced by architecture tests, CQRS, a transactional outbox on Wolverine (RabbitMQ and Kafka optional), Marten event sourcing and EF Core on PostgreSQL, OpenIddict (PKCE for apps and services) with 2FA, impersonation, audit trail and multi-tenancy, an Angular SPA on a secure cookie session (BFF) with a typed API client, OpenTelemetry, security headers and CSP, hardened containers, and a full unit, integration and architecture test suite. Includes enterprise-modular (full solution) and enterprise-modular-module (add and wire a new module).
title: Enterprise Modular Monolith Templates
